facts.fact: UNDP Niger says the commune urbaine of Diffa put Naneye Yarda into service on 11 December 2025, a system covering the whole tax cycle: a digital census of taxable establishments by agents with tablets, automatic tax calculation, tax notices with QR codes, and payment by electronic terminals carried by tax collectors.

UNDP Niger says Diffa is the first region outside the capital to deploy the full digitalisation of municipal taxation; it gives no count of communes in the country, and the document names no other commune outside Niamey.
UNDP Niger reports the commune urbaine of Diffa commissioned the Naneye Yarda municipal tax system on 11 December 2025, replacing manual collection with incomplete taxpayer files.

systems.owner: Commune urbaine de Diffa, with technical support from ANSI and UNDP
systems.tiers: commune urbaine of Diffa, the first outside the capital
